segments.name: Buprenorphine-based prescription drugs
segments.description: Develops, manufactures and sells buprenorphine-based prescription drugs for the treatment of opioid dependence and related disorders.
segments.evidence: The Company operates as one business segment, which is predominantly the development, manufacture and sale of buprenorphine-based prescription drugs for the treatment of opioid dependence and related disorders.

revenueModel.text: The company earns net revenue from selling its prescription drugs through wholesalers and other channels to payors including commercial managed care, Medicaid, federal purchasers and cash-paying pharmacies.
revenueModel.evidence: In the U.S., we have distribution agreements with the three largest wholesalers, which accounted for 51% and 55% of our global net revenue in 2025 and 2024, respectively.

changes.text: In 2025, the Company cancelled its secondary listing on the London Stock Exchange after moving its primary listing to Nasdaq in 2024.
changes.evidence: We continued to have a secondary listing on the LSE where our ordinary shares traded on the Equity Shares (Transition) category until July 24, 2025, after which we cancelled our LSE listing.
